description:
Follow-on to the VDom epic. Once d06.6 (Screen root + UI.Slots
registry) and d06.13/14 (dialogs + selectors as overlay components)
are in, expose the upstream pi-mono extension surface to octo_pi
extension authors:

  * `Coder.Extensions.UI.set_header(api, mod | nil)`
  * `Coder.Extensions.UI.set_footer(api, mod | nil)`
  * `Coder.Extensions.UI.set_widget(api, key, mod | nil, opts \\ [])`
  * `Coder.Extensions.UI.register_message_renderer(api, type, mod)`
  * `Coder.Extensions.UI.set_status(api, text | nil)`
  * `Coder.Extensions.UI.set_title(api, title)`
  * `Coder.Extensions.UI.custom(api, factory, opts) :: {:ok, result}`
    (focus-grabbing overlay; resolves when the component calls
    `done(result)`)

Each function casts a `{:slot_override, …}` / `{:renderer_register,
…}` / `{:overlay_push, …}` message to Interactive, which folds it
into `UI.State` via `UI.Slots.override/3` (or the renderer
registry / overlay slot equivalent) and pushes affected ids into
the invalidated set.

References (upstream):
  - `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts`
    (the `ExtensionUI` interface, ~line 160-200).
  - `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/custom-header.ts`
    `custom-footer.ts`, `message-renderer.ts`,
    `widget-placement.ts`, `doom-overlay/`.

Acceptance:
  * An extension can replace the header at runtime; visual smoke
    test in tmux confirms the swap with no flicker.
  * A custom message-type renderer survives a full TUI lifecycle
    (registered → received → rendered → unregistered).
  * `Coder.Extensions.UI.custom/3` can show an overlay that
    captures keys until `done/1` is called; existing
    overlay-non-capturing behaviour still available via opts.
  * Test parity with upstream's
    `compaction-extensions.test.ts`, `extensions-input-event.test.ts`
    where the equivalent UI override paths exist.

Out of scope: the loader/discovery side of extensions
(`Coder.Extensions.Loader`) — that lives elsewhere. This ticket is
strictly about the UI plumbing exposed to already-loaded
extensions.
title: Coder.Extensions.UI: wire slot registry + message renderer registry to the extension API
